notes.title: BloodNet made cyberpunk even more dystopian by adding vampires
notes.notes: From 2010 to 2014 Richard Cobbett wrote Crapshoot, a column about rolling the dice to bring random obscure games back into the light. This week, you know how they say technology destroys your soul? Pffft. Compared to old school methods of damnation, it's a rank amateur at best... Read more.
